# JTV 1.5.12

> Install `JTV-v1.5.12.apk` over your current version. Your login and favourites are kept.

## What's new
- **Open when the TV turns on** (requested in #8). Settings → Playback → *Open When the TV Turns On*: **After the box starts up**, or **Also after standby** for TVs that only sleep when switched off. With *Autoplay Last Channel* on, the TV goes straight to your last channel, like a normal TV. On Android 10 and newer, JTV asks once for **Display over other apps** and opens that setting for you.
- **Guide fixed after midnight.** For a few hours after midnight, Jio's guide still sends the previous day, so the current show was missing. JTV now also loads the next day.

## Install
1. Download `JTV-v1.5.12.apk` below.
2. Open it on your TV or phone (allow installs from this source if asked).

Full list of changes: see the [README](https://github.com/F-e-n-y-x/JioTV-AndroidTV-/blob/main/README.md).
